mairie.pageTitle: Civil Wedding - Documents and Procedures | Mariable
mairie.pageDescription: Complete guide for your civil wedding: required documents, conditions, deadlines and steps to get married at the city hall.
mairie.premiumDesc: Download the full document checklist for your civil wedding.
mairie.title: Civil Wedding - City Hall
mairie.subtitle: Complete guide to administrative procedures
mairie.importantText: The civil wedding must legally take place before any religious ceremony. Documents and deadlines may vary between city halls — always check your local city hall's official website.
mairie.conditionsNote: Note: In exceptional cases, a dispensation for family ties may be granted by the President of the Republic.
conditions: Marriage allowed between same-sex or different-sex couples (law of 17 May 2013)
Have no close family or marital ties with the future spouse
Not already be married in France or abroad

lieux.description: No minimum length of residence required
Town of residence of either spouse's father or mother

mairie.parisText: The wedding is held in the arrondissement matching the home or residence address.
mairie.capacityText: Varies between city halls — be sure to ask!
mairie.datesText: Set by the Mayor based on the availability of staff, deputies authorised to celebrate weddings, and venues.

documents.title: ID document
documents.description: National ID card, passport OR driving licence

documents.title: Recent proof of address
documents.description: Rent receipt, electricity, water or phone bill...

documents.title: Birth certificate (full copy)
documents.description: Less than 3 months old if born in France / less than 6 months if issued by a consulate

documents.title: List of witnesses
documents.description: 1 or 2 witnesses per spouse (max 2 per partner)
documents.detail: Names, dates/places of birth, occupation, address

documents.title: Notary certificate
documents.description: Only if a marriage contract has been signed

bans.condition: Both spouses live in the same town
One spouse lives in a different town

documents: Death certificate of the previous spouse
Birth certificate with marginal note of divorce
Written consent of the guardian or curator
For persons under guardianship: doctor's certificate confirming a favourable opinion
If non-French speaking: sworn translator required on the wedding day
Translator's details must be provided at least 6 days before the wedding
All foreign documents must be translated into French by a sworn translator
Documents legalised or certified with an apostille depending on the country
Specific documents may be required depending on nationality (check with city hall or consulate)

etapes.title: Prepare the file
etapes.description: Gather all required documents. Check on your city hall's official website as requirements may vary.

etapes.title: Book an appointment
etapes.description: Contact the city hall 2-3 months before the desired date to schedule a filing appointment.

etapes.title: File submission meeting
etapes.description: Attend with your complete file. The civil registrar may request a joint hearing of the future spouses.

etapes.title: Banns publication
etapes.description: Mandatory display for 10 days at the city hall. Deadlines vary depending on your situation (4 to 8 weeks).

etapes.title: Civil ceremony
etapes.description: Official celebration by the civil registrar in the presence of your witnesses. Duration: about 20-30 minutes.

mairie.liensNote: These links lead to the official site service-public.gouv.fr
knowItems: The civil registrar may request a joint hearing of the future spouses
The ceremony takes place in the wedding hall of the city hall
The family record book will be given to you at the end of the ceremony
For non-French-speaking foreign spouses, a sworn translator is mandatory on the day

pdf.subtitle: Civil Wedding Checklist - Documents to prepare
items: ID document spouse 1 (ID card, passport or licence)
ID document spouse 2 (ID card, passport or licence)
Birth certificate spouse 1 (full copy, less than 3 months old)
Birth certificate spouse 2 (full copy, less than 3 months old)
optional: Birth certificate with divorce note (if divorced)
Translated and legalised documents (if foreign spouse)
delays: - 4 weeks if both spouses live in the same town
- 6 weeks if one lives in a different town
pdf.note1: Note: Dates and times depend on the city hall's availability.
pdf.note2: Room capacity varies between city halls - ask in advance!
